limits: Exact source completion/catch suffix with four synthetic failed containers; positive/partial use two archived synthetic cards. Render-error uses an injected throw at renderer boundary; original render is exercised on positive/partial. Actual message fallback with model_mova=off. Cached Pyodide indexURL points to localhost, TMPDIR on own overlay after shared /tmp filled. Relative display fonts may fall back. No full model build, photo quality, global AA or screen-reader audio claim.
